prompt_used: Short memorable audio logo / sonic brand for a warm, smart, playful Vietnamese AI-education channel hosted by a friendly 3D-animated host. 2-3 seconds, 3-5 note motif (marimba/pluck + soft synth pad + subtle sparkle), ends on a resolved bright chord, modern and premium, not cheesy, no vocals. Provide 3 variations. Synthesized programmatically with original motifs, not a generated video soundtrack and not copied from any existing song.
issues: Synthesized programmatically (sine/harmonic plucks + pad + echo) rather than a studio-recorded performance; timbre is clean but simpler than a full studio logo.
